rows.name: Vowel team words: ow, oi, ear, air, ure
steps: Write words on cards (cow, coin, ear, hair, cure) and set out five headings: ow, oi, ear, air, ure.
Ask pairs to take turns drawing a card, reading it aloud and placing it under its heading.
Call out a pattern and have children hold up a matching card.
Finish with a quick race to find one card for each heading.
